title: Songs and Dances of the Dagaaba of West Africa - DocsLib
text: 1. Introduction This recording was part of a research project that focussed on the language and music of the Dagaare- speaking people of the Republic of Ghana, West Africa. It is intended to document songs, proverbs, riddles, spoken and sung folktales, instrumental music and dance performances, in particular ba waa, in their “natural” contexts.
